title: Uruguay
goal: Read how President Bordaberry's 1973 self-coup led to a twelve-year dictatorship with one of the world's highest per-capita rates of political prisoners, and how a rejected 1980 constitution set an early path back to democracy.

items: Explain what Bordaberry did on June 27, 1973.
Describe the Tupamaros' role leading up to the coup.
State the cited rate of political prisoners under the dictatorship.
Describe what happened in the November 1980 plebiscite.
Use por su parte to introduce a new case in a comparison.
